units.zh: 開平四年十月乙亥，東京博王友文入覲，召之也。
units.en: On yihai in the tenth month of Kaiping 4, Prince of Bo Youwen at the Eastern Capital entered court; he had been summoned.
units.literal: On yihai, tenth month of Kaiping 4, Prince of Bo Youwen of the Eastern Capital came to audience—it was a summons.

units.zh: 己卯，以新修天驥院開宴落成，內外並獻馬，而魏博進絹四萬匹為駔價。
units.en: On jimao, to mark completion of the newly rebuilt Heavenly Steeds Park, court and country presented horses; Weibo sent forty thousand bolts of silk as stud fees.
units.literal: On jimao, because the newly repaired Heavenly Steeds Park held a feast for its completion, inside and outside alike presented horses, and Weibo sent forty thousand bolts of silk as stud price.

units.zh: 壬午，以冬設禁軍，幸興安鞠場，召文武百官宴。
units.en: On renwu, with winter drill for the Palace Army, he went to Xing’an Ball Ground and feasted the full civil and military establishment.
units.literal: On renwu, because winter was setting in for the Palace Army, he visited Xing’an Ball Ground and summoned civil and military officials to a feast.

units.zh: 幸開化，大閱軍實。
units.en: He went to Kaihua and held a grand inspection of arms and stores.
units.literal: He visited Kaihua and conducted a great review of military stores.

units.zh: 十一月丁亥朔，幸廣王第作樂。
units.en: On dinghai, the first of the eleventh month, he went to the Prince of Guang’s mansion for music.
units.literal: On dinghai, first day of the eleventh month, he visited the Prince of Guang’s residence for music.

units.zh: 辛卯，宴文武四品已上于宣威殿。
units.en: On xinmao he gave civil and military officials of fourth rank and above a feast at Xuanwei Hall.
units.literal: On xinmao he feasted civil and military officials of fourth rank and above at Xuanwei Hall.

units.zh: 庚戌，幸左龍虎軍，宴群臣。
units.en: On gengxu he went to the Left Dragon-Tiger Army and feasted the ministers.
units.literal: On gengxu he visited the Left Dragon-Tiger Army and feasted the ministers.

units.zh: 甲寅，幸右龍虎軍，宴群臣。
units.en: On jiayin he went to the Right Dragon-Tiger Army and feasted the ministers.
units.literal: On jiayin he visited the Right Dragon-Tiger Army and feasted the ministers.

units.zh: 戊戌，詔曰：「自朔至今，暴風未息，諒惟不德，致此咎征。
units.en: On wuxu an edict read: "Since the new moon, violent winds have not stopped. I alone lack virtue and have drawn down this portent.
units.literal: On wuxu an edict stated: "From the new moon until now violent winds have not ceased—I alone lack virtue and have brought on this ill omen.

units.zh: 皇天動威，罔敢不懼。
units.en: Heaven has stirred its might; none may fail to fear.
units.literal: Heaven has shown its wrath; who would not fear?

units.zh: 宜遍命祈禱，副朕意焉。」
units.en: Let prayers be ordered throughout the realm to match my intent."
units.literal: Prayers should be ordered everywhere to accord with my intent."

units.zh: 差官分往祠所止風。
units.en: Envoys were sent to various shrines to pray for the wind to cease.
units.literal: Officials were dispatched separately to shrines to halt the wind.

units.zh: 己亥，日南至，帝被袞冕禦朝元殿，列細仗，奏樂於庭，群臣稱賀。
units.en: On jihai, the winter solstice, the Emperor wore full regalia at Chaoyuan Hall, drew up the detailed guard, had music in the courtyard, and received congratulations from the ministers.
units.literal: On jihai, the winter solstice, the Emperor donned ceremonial robes and presided at Chaoyuan Hall, arrayed the detailed guard, music played in the courtyard, and the ministers offered congratulations.

units.zh: 帝畋于伊水。
units.en: The Emperor hunted along the Yi River.
units.literal: The Emperor hunted on the Yi River.

units.zh: 乙巳，詔曰：「關防者，所以識異服、察異言也。
units.en: On yisi an edict read: "Frontier posts exist to spot foreign dress and foreign speech.
units.literal: On yisi an edict stated: "Frontier posts exist to recognize alien dress and detect alien speech.

units.zh: 況下天未息，兵民多奸，改形易衣，覘我戎事。
units.en: The realm is still unsettled and soldiers and civilians are rife with deceit; they disguise themselves to spy on our armies.
units.literal: Moreover the realm is not yet at peace and soldiers and people are full of treachery—they change their appearance and clothes to spy on our military affairs.

units.zh: 比者有諜皆以詐敗，而未嘗罪所過地，叛將逃卒竊其妻孥而影附使者，亦未嘗詰其所經。
units.en: Lately every spy has been caught by trickery, yet the districts they passed through went unpunished; defecting officers and runaway soldiers stole families and trailed behind envoys, yet no one questioned their route.
units.literal: Lately spies have all been exposed by fraud, yet the places they passed through were never punished; rebel generals and fugitive soldiers stole away wives and children and shadowed envoys, yet where they traveled was never investigated.

units.zh: 今海內未同，而緩法弛禁，非所以息奸詐、止奔亡也。
units.en: The empire is not yet one, yet the law is lax and the gates open—no way to curb deceit or stop desertion.
units.literal: Now the realm is not yet united, yet laws are slack and prohibitions loose—this is no way to end fraud or stop flight.

units.zh: 應在京諸司，不得擅給公驗。
units.en: No capital agency may issue travel passes on its own.
units.literal: All offices in the capital must not issue official passes on their own authority.

units.zh: 如有出外須執憑由者，其司門過所，先須經中書門下點檢，宜委宰臣趙光逢專判出給，俾由顯重，冀絕奸源。
units.en: Anyone leaving the capital with papers must have Gate Office permits checked first by the Secretariat-Chancellery; chief minister Zhao Guangfeng alone should issue them, so the trail is weighty and treachery choked at the source.
units.literal: If anyone going out must carry credentials, the Gate Office travel permit must first be inspected by the Secretariat-Chancellery; chief minister Zhao Guangfeng should be charged solely with issuing them, so that the route is weighty and the source of treachery cut off.

units.zh: 仍下兩京、河陽及六軍諸衛、御史台，各加鈐轄。
units.en: The same order went to both capitals, Heyang, the Six Armies guards, and the Censorate to tighten oversight.
units.literal: The order was also sent to the two capitals, Heyang, the Six Armies guards, and the Censorate, each to tighten control.

units.zh: 公私行李，復不得帶挾家口向西。
units.en: Private and official baggage might no longer take dependents west.
units.literal: Private and official baggage again must not carry family members westward.

units.zh: 其襄、鄧、鄜、延等道，並同處分。」
units.en: The Xiang, Deng, Fu, and Yan circuits received the same rules."
units.literal: The Xiang, Deng, Fu, and Yan circuits were to be handled the same way."

units.zh: 以甯國軍節度使王景仁充北面行營都招討使，潞州副招討使韓勍為副，相州刺史李思安為先鋒使。
units.en: Wang Jingren, Ningguo commissioner, became overall northern campaign commander; Han Qin, Luzhou deputy, his second; Li Si’an, Xiangzhou prefect, vanguard.
units.literal: Ningguo military commissioner Wang Jingren was made overall northern campaign commander; Luzhou deputy commander Han Qin was his second; Xiangzhou prefect Li Si’an was vanguard commander.

units.zh: 時鎮州王熔、定州王處直叛，結連晉人，故遣將討之。
units.en: Wang Rong of Zhenzhou and Wang Chuzhi of Dingzhou had rebelled and joined the Jin, so troops were sent against them.
units.literal: At the time Zhenzhou’s Wang Rong and Dingzhou’s Wang Chuzhi had rebelled and allied with the Jin, so generals were sent to attack them.

units.zh: 《五代會要》：十一月十四日，司天奏：「月蝕，不宜用兵。」
units.en: 《Five Dynasties Huiyao》: On the fourteenth of the eleventh month the Directorate of Astronomy memorialized: "There will be a lunar eclipse; it is inauspicious to use arms."
units.literal: 《Five Dynasties Huiyao》: On the fourteenth of the eleventh month the Directorate of Astronomy reported: "A lunar eclipse—war should not be waged."

units.zh: 時王景仁方總大軍北伐，追之不及。
units.en: Wang Jingren was already at the head of the main northern force; the recall did not overtake him.
units.literal: At the time Wang Jingren was already leading the great army north; the recall could not reach him in time.

units.zh: 至五年正月二日，果為後唐莊宗大敗于柏鄉。
units.en: On the second of the first month of the fifth year he was indeed crushed at Baixiang by Zhuangzong of Later Tang.
units.literal: By the second of the first month of year five he was indeed routed at Baixiang by Later Tang’s Zhuangzong.

units.zh: 十二月辛酉，宴文武四品已上于宣威殿。
units.en: On xinyou in the twelfth month he feasted officials of fourth rank and above at Xuanwei Hall.
units.literal: On xinyou of the twelfth month he feasted civil and military officials of fourth rank and above at Xuanwei Hall.

units.zh: 親閱禁軍，命格鬥于教馬亭。
units.en: He personally inspected the Palace Army and ordered hand-to-hand drill at Jiaoma Pavilion.
units.literal: He personally reviewed the Palace Army and ordered grappling at Jiaoma Pavilion.

units.zh: 己巳，詔曰：「滑、宋、輝、亳等州，水澇敗傷，人戶愁歎，朕為民父母，良用痛心。
units.en: On jisi an edict read: "Hua, Song, Hui, and Bo have been ruined by floods; the people lament. As their parent, I am deeply grieved.
units.literal: On jisi an edict stated: "Hua, Song, Hui, and Bo prefectures have suffered flood damage; households groan in distress—as parent to the people I am deeply pained.

units.zh: 其令本州分等級賑貸，所在長吏監臨周給，務令存濟。」
units.en: Each prefecture should grade households and lend relief; local magistrates must oversee full distribution and keep people alive."
units.literal: Let each prefecture grade and lend relief grain; local magistrates shall supervise thorough distribution and strive to keep the people alive."

units.zh: 壬辰，賑貸東都畿內，如宋、滑制。
units.en: On renchen relief was extended within the Eastern Capital region on the Song and Hua model.
units.literal: On renchen relief was lent within the Eastern Capital metropolitan belt, following the Song and Hua rules.

units.zh: 乾化元年正月丙戌朔，日有食之，帝素服避殿，百官守司以恭天事，明復而止。
units.en: On bingxu, New Year’s Day of Ganhua 1, an eclipse occurred; the Emperor wore plain dress and stayed off the throne, officials kept their posts in reverence for Heaven, and when the light returned they resumed.
units.literal: On bingxu, first day of the first month of Ganhua 1, there was an eclipse; the Emperor wore plain robes and avoided the hall, officials kept their posts to honor Heaven, and when brightness returned they stopped.

units.zh: 制曰：「兩漢以來，日食地震，百官各上封事，指陳得失。
units.en: An edict read: "Since Han times, at eclipses and earthquakes every official has submitted sealed memorials on what is right and wrong.
units.literal: An edict stated: "Since the two Han dynasties, at solar eclipses and earthquakes all officials submitted sealed memorials pointing out gains and losses.

units.zh: 蓋欲周知時病，盡達物情，用緝國章，以奉天誡。
units.en: The aim was to know the times’ ills, convey every grievance, mend the state’s laws, and heed Heaven’s warning.
units.literal: The aim was to know the age’s ills thoroughly, convey all conditions, knit the state’s laws, and honor Heaven’s warning.

units.zh: 朕每思逆耳，罔忌觸鱗，將洽政經，庶開言路。
units.en: I have always welcomed blunt counsel and do not fear offending; I mean to set policy straight and open the road of remonstrance.
units.literal: I always welcome words that sting the ear and do not fear touching the scales; I wish to align governance and open the path of speech.

units.zh: 況茲謫見，當有咎征。
units.en: This rebuke in the heavens surely marks some fault below.
units.literal: Moreover this reprimand in the sky surely has a portent behind it.

units.zh: 其在列辟群臣，危言正諫，極萬邦之利害，致六合之殷昌。
units.en: Let every lord and minister speak harsh truth, lay bare the realm’s harms and gains, and bring the four quarters to prosperity.
units.literal: Let all feudal lords and ministers speak harsh truth and straight remonstrance, exhaust the realm’s harm and benefit, and bring the six directions to abundance.

units.zh: 毗予一人，永建皇極。」
units.en: Stand with me and long uphold the throne."
units.literal: Assist me alone and forever establish the supreme pole."

units.zh: 二日，日旁有祲氣，向背若環耳。
units.en: On the second day a sinister halo ringed the sun fore and aft.
units.literal: On the second day there was a baleful aura beside the sun, front and back like a ring.

units.zh: 崇政使敬翔望之曰：「兵可憂矣！」
units.en: Jing Xiang, Chongzheng commissioner, watching it, said: "The armies are in peril!"
units.literal: Chongzheng commissioner Jing Xiang, observing it, said: "The army is to be feared!"

units.zh: 帝為之旰食。
units.en: The Emperor could not eat for worry.
units.literal: The Emperor lost his appetite over it.

units.zh: 是日，果為晉軍及鎮、定之師所敗，都將十餘人被擒，餘眾奔潰。
units.en: That day the army was indeed beaten by the Jin and the Zhen and Ding armies; a dozen commanders were taken and the rest broke and ran.
units.literal: That very day he was indeed defeated by the Jin army and the Zhen and Ding forces; more than ten commanders were captured and the rest fled in rout.

units.zh: 庚寅，制曰：「扈氏不恭，固難去戰，鬼方未服，尚或勞師。
units.en: On gengyin an edict read: "The Hu were unruly and war was hard to end; Guifang had not submitted and armies were still worn.
units.literal: On gengyin an edict stated: "The Hu clan was unruly—it was hard to leave off war; the Guifang were not yet subdued—troops might still be wearied.

units.zh: 其蟻聚餘妖，狐鳴丑類，棄天常而拒命，據地險以偷生，言事討除，將期戡定。
units.en: These swarming remnants and yelping rabble defied Heaven, held rough country, and clung to life; the campaign to crush them should soon succeed.
units.literal: These ant-swarm remnants and fox-crying rabble abandoned Heaven’s constant and defied orders, held rugged ground and clung to life—when we speak of punishing them, we expect soon to pacify them.

units.zh: 問罪止誅於元惡，挺災可憫于遺黎，每念傷痍，良深愧歎。
units.en: Punishment should fall on ringleaders alone; when calamity spreads, pity the people left behind. I brood on the harm done and sigh in shame.
units.literal: When asking guilt, punish only the chief villains; when disaster strikes, pity the survivors—I think constantly of the wounded and sigh in deep shame.

units.zh: 應天兵所至之地，宜令將帥節級嚴戒軍伍，不得焚燒廬舍，開發丘壟，毀廢農桑，驅掠士女。
units.en: Wherever the imperial army marches, commanders must strictly forbid troops to burn homes, open graves, ruin crops, or seize men and women.
units.literal: Wherever the imperial army goes, commanders should strictly warn their troops: they must not burn houses, open tombs, ruin farming, or drive off men and women.

units.zh: 使其背叛之俗，知予吊伐之心。」
units.en: Let rebel lands know that I come to punish the guilty and comfort the people."
units.literal: Let the rebel country know my heart in coming to comfort and punish."

units.zh: 又制曰：「戎機方切，國用未殷，養兵須藉於賦租，稅粟尚煩於力役。
units.en: Another edict read: "War is urgent and the treasury thin—armies live on tax grain, yet levies still press the people.
units.literal: Another edict stated: "Military urgency is pressing and the treasury is not full—soldiers must be fed from tax grain, and grain tax still burdens corvée.

units.zh: 所在長吏，不得因緣徵發，自務貪求，苟有故違，必行重典。
units.en: Local magistrates must not use the crisis to levy more and line their pockets; violators will face the severest penalties.
units.literal: Local magistrates must not use the occasion to levy extra and seek their own greed; if anyone knowingly violates this, heavy law will be applied.

units.zh: 立法垂制，詳刑定科，傳之無窮，守而勿失。
units.en: Laws and systems, punishments and statutes—let them be handed down forever and kept without fail.
units.literal: To establish law and hand down systems, to detail punishments and fix statutes—transmit them without end and keep them without loss.

units.zh: 中書門下所奏新定格式律令，已頒下中外，各委所在長吏，切務遵行。
units.en: The new formats, statutes, and ordinances from the Secretariat-Chancellery are promulgated everywhere; every local magistrate must obey them.
units.literal: The newly fixed formats, statutes, and ordinances reported by the Secretariat-Chancellery have been issued inside and outside; each local magistrate must earnestly obey.

units.zh: 盡革煩苛，皆除枉濫，用副哀矜之旨，無違欽恤之言。」
units.en: Cut harshness and wrongful abuse, to match compassionate rule and honor merciful judgment."
units.literal: Cut all harsh excess, remove all wrongful abuse, to match the intent of compassion and not betray the charge of merciful judgment."

units.zh: 詔征陝州鎮國軍節度使楊師厚至京，見於崇勳殿。
units.en: Yang Shihou, Zhenguo commissioner of Shaanxi, was summoned to court and received at Chongxun Hall.
units.literal: An edict summoned Shaanxi Zhenguo military commissioner Yang Shihou to the capital; he was received at Chongxun Hall.

units.zh: 帝指授方略，依前充北面都招討使，恩賚甚厚，使督軍進發。
units.en: The Emperor laid out strategy in person, reappointed him overall northern commander, heaped rewards on him, and sent him to lead the advance.
units.literal: The Emperor personally set strategy; as before he was made overall northern commander; favors were very generous and he was sent to supervise the army’s advance.

units.zh: 《五代會要》：二月，晉師侵魏州，楊師厚帥師援邢州，晉人還師。
units.en: 《Five Dynasties Huiyao》: In the second month Jin forces struck Weizhou; Yang Shihou marched to relieve Xingzhou and the Jin pulled back.
units.literal: 《Five Dynasties Huiyao》: In the second month Jin troops raided Weizhou; Yang Shihou led troops to relieve Xingzhou and the Jin withdrew.

units.zh: 二月丙辰朔，帝御文明殿，群臣入閣。
units.en: On bingchen, the first of the second month, the Emperor held Wenhua Hall and the ministers entered the side hall.
units.literal: On bingchen, first day of the second month, the Emperor presided at Wenhua Hall and the ministers entered the side hall.

units.zh: 以蔡州順化軍指揮使王存儼權知軍州事。
units.en: Wang Cunyan, Shunhua Army commander at Cai, was made acting prefect and military commissioner.
units.literal: Wang Cunyan, commander of Shunhua Army at Cai Prefecture, was made acting military prefect.

units.zh: 蔡人久習叛逆，刺史張慎思又裒斂無狀，帝追慎思至京，而久未命代。
units.en: Cai had long bred rebels; Prefect Zhang Shensi extorted without limit. The Emperor recalled Shensi to court but left the post empty for months.
units.literal: The people of Cai had long been used to rebellion; prefect Zhang Shensi also extorted without restraint; the Emperor recalled Shensi to the capital but for a long time appointed no replacement.

units.zh: 右廂指揮使劉行琮乘虛作亂，因縱火驅擁，為渡淮計。
units.en: Right-wing commander Liu Xingcong seized the gap to revolt, set fires to drive the mob, and aimed to cross the Huai.
units.literal: Right-wing commander Liu Xingcong seized the moment to rebel, set fires to drive the crowd, and planned to cross the Huai.

units.zh: 存儼誅行琮而撫遏其眾，都將鄭遵與其下奉存儼為主，而以眾情馳奏。
units.en: Cunyan killed Xingcong and calmed the host; Commander Zheng Zun and the men raised Cunyan and raced a memorial on the army’s choice.
units.literal: Cunyan killed Xingcong and pacified the troops; commander Zheng Zun and his men made Cunyan leader and galloped a memorial on the army’s will.

units.zh: 時東京留守博王友文不先請，遂討其亂。
units.en: Eastern Capital regent Prince of Bo Youwen marched to crush the revolt without waiting for orders.
units.literal: At the time Eastern Capital regent Prince of Bo Youwen did not ask first but set out to suppress the disorder.

units.zh: 兵至鄢陵，上聞之曰：「誅行琮功也，然存儼方懼，若臨之以兵，蔡必速飛矣！」
units.en: At Yanling the Emperor heard and said: "Killing Xingcong is merit, but Cunyan is terrified; if we march on him in force, Cai will bolt overnight!"
units.literal: When the army reached Yanling the sovereign heard and said: "Killing Xingcong is merit—but Cunyan is still afraid; if we press him with troops, Cai will flee at once!"

units.zh: 遂馳使還軍，而擢授存儼，蔡人安之。
units.en: He at once recalled the army, promoted Cunyan, and Cai settled down.
units.literal: He immediately sent orders to recall the army, promoted Cunyan, and the people of Cai were reassured.

units.zh: 壬戌，詔曰：「東京舊邦，久不巡幸，宜以今月九日幸東都，扈從文武官委中書門下量閑劇處分。」
units.en: On renxu an edict read: "The Eastern Capital is our ancient seat and long neglected; I shall visit it on the ninth of this month. Civil and military followers will be assigned by the Secretariat-Chancellery by priority."
units.literal: On renxu an edict stated: "The Eastern Capital is our old seat and long unvisited; on the ninth of this month I should visit the Eastern Capital; civil and military followers are to be assigned by the Secretariat-Chancellery according to urgency."

units.zh: 宰臣上言曰：「龍興天府，久望法駕，但陛下始康愈，未宜涉寒，願少留清蹕。」
units.en: The chief ministers said: "The Eastern Capital has long awaited your presence, but you have only just recovered and should not brave the cold; we beg a little more time."
units.literal: The chief ministers memorialized: "The dragon rises in the heavenly seat and long awaits your chariot—but Your Majesty has only just recovered and should not brave the cold; we beg you to linger a while longer."

units.zh: 從之。
units.en: He agreed.
units.literal: He assented.

units.zh: 《五代會要》：二月，敕：「食人之食者，憂人之事，況丞相尊位，參決大政，而堂封未給，且無餐錢，朕甚愧之。
units.en: 《Five Dynasties Huiyao》: In the second month an order read: "Those fed by the state should care for its business—how much more the chancellor, who decides great affairs, yet receives no hall stipend and no meal allowance. I am ashamed.
units.literal: 《Five Dynasties Huiyao》: In the second month an order stated: "Those who eat the people’s food should worry over the people’s affairs—how much more the chancellor’s exalted post, deciding great policy, yet hall stipend unpaid and no meal money—I am deeply ashamed.

units.zh: 宜令食萬錢之半。」
units.en: Let them receive half the usual ten-thousand-cash meal allowance."
units.literal: Let them receive half of ten thousand cash in food allowance."

units.zh: 甲子，幸曜村民舍閱農事。
units.en: On jiazi he visited a farmhouse at Yaocun to inspect the crops.
units.literal: On jiazi he visited a farmhouse at Yaocun to inspect farming.

units.zh: 庚午，幸白馬坡。
units.en: On gengwu he went to Baima Slope.
units.literal: On gengwu he visited Baima Slope.

units.zh: 詔金吾大將軍、待制官各奏事。
units.en: An edict required the Commandant of the Gold Crow and awaiting-appointment officials each to report on affairs.
units.literal: An edict ordered the Commandant of the Gold Crow and awaiting-appointment officials each to memorialize on affairs.

units.zh: 武安軍節度使馬殷進呈虔州刺史盧延昌箋表。
units.en: Ma Yin, Wuan commissioner, presented the memorial and petition of Lu Yanchang, Qianzhou prefect.
units.literal: Wuan military commissioner Ma Yin presented the memorial and petition of Qianzhou prefect Lu Yanchang.

units.zh: 虔州本支郡也，兵甚銳，自得韶州益強大，升為百勝軍使。
units.en: Qianzhou had been a subordinate prefecture with fierce troops; after Shaozhou it grew stronger and was raised to Hundred Victories Army commander.
units.literal: Qianzhou was originally a branch prefecture with very sharp troops; since taking Shaozhou it grew stronger and was promoted to commander of the Hundred Victories Army.

units.zh: 始洪州之陷，盧光稠願收復使府，立功自效，上因兼授江西觀察留後。
units.en: When Hongzhou fell, Lu Guangchou sought to retake the seat and prove himself; the Emperor therefore named him acting Jiangxi observation commissioner as well.
units.literal: When Hongzhou first fell, Lu Guangchou wished to recover the commissioner’s seat and earn merit; the sovereign therefore also made him Jiangxi observation commissioner on probation.

units.zh: 光稠卒，復命延昌領州事，方伯亦頗慰薦。
units.en: When Guangchou died, Yanchang was again put in charge of the prefecture; the regional commissioner strongly recommended him.
units.literal: When Guangchou died, Yanchang was again ordered to hold the prefecture; the regional commissioner also recommended him warmly.

units.zh: 楊渭遣人偽署爵秩，延昌佯受官牒，禮遣其使，因湖南自表其事曰：「郡小寇迫，欲緩其奸謀，且開導貢路，非敢貳也。」
units.en: Yang Wei sent men to grant forged ranks; Yanchang feigned acceptance, courteously dismissed the envoys, and through Hunan reported: "Our district is small and rebels close in—I mean to stall their plots and keep tribute moving; I do not mean to defect."
units.literal: Yang Wei sent men to forge titles of rank; Yanchang pretended to accept the commission, courteously sent the envoys off, and through Hunan memorialized himself: "The prefecture is small and bandits press close—I wish to slow their plots and keep the tribute road open; I do not dare to turn disloyal."

units.zh: 以其偽制來自陳，上覽奏曰：「我方有北事，不可不甚加撫恤。」
units.en: He presented the forged patent; reading the memorial the Emperor said: "With northern war on hand we must treat him generously."
units.literal: He came forward with the forged commission; reading the memorial the sovereign said: "We have northern business and cannot fail to treat him generously."

units.zh: 尋兼授鎮南將軍節度使觀察留後，命使慰勞。
units.en: Soon he was also named Zhennan general, military commissioner, and acting observation commissioner, and envoys were sent to comfort him.
units.literal: Soon he was also made Zhennan general, military commissioner, and observation commissioner on probation, and envoys were sent to console him.

units.zh: 《九國志》：盧延昌歸命于吳，偽乞命于梁。
units.en: 《Nine States Annals》: Lu Yanchang submitted to Wu while pretending to seek office from Liang.
units.literal: 《Nine States Annals》: Lu Yanchang submitted to Wu while falsely begging office from Liang.

units.zh: 三月辛卯，以久旱，令宰臣分禱靈跡。
units.en: On xinmao in the third month, after long drought, he sent chief ministers to pray at sacred sites in turn.
units.literal: On xinmao of the third month, because of long drought, he ordered chief ministers to pray separately at numinous sites.

units.zh: 翼日，大澍雨。
units.en: The next day came a soaking rain.
units.literal: The next day there was a great soaking rain.

units.zh: 丙申，幸甘水亭，召宰臣、翰林學士、尚書侍郎孔續已下八人扈從，宴樂甚歡。
units.en: On bingshen at Ganshui Pavilion he took chief ministers, Hanlin scholars, and Vice Minister Kong Xu and seven others in attendance and feasted with great delight.
units.literal: On bingshen he visited Ganshui Pavilion, summoned chief ministers, Hanlin academicians, and Vice Minister of the Secretariat Kong Xu and seven others below him to attend, and feasted with great joy.

units.zh: 戊戌，幸右龍虎軍，召文武官四品已上宴於新殿。
units.en: On wuxu he went to the Right Dragon-Tiger Army and feasted officials of fourth rank and above in the new hall.
units.literal: On wuxu he visited the Right Dragon-Tiger Army and summoned civil and military officials of fourth rank and above to feast in the new hall.

units.zh: 甲辰，幸左龍虎軍新殿，宴文武官四品已上。
units.en: On jiachen he went to the Left Dragon-Tiger Army’s new hall and feasted officials of fourth rank and above.
units.literal: On jiachen he visited the new hall of the Left Dragon-Tiger Army and feasted civil and military officials of fourth rank and above.

units.zh: 四月丁卯，幸龍虎門，召宰臣、學士、金吾上將軍、大將軍侍宴廣化寺。
units.en: On dingmao in the fourth month he went to Longhu Gate, called chief ministers, scholars, senior Gold Crow generals, and great generals to feast at Guanghua Monastery.
units.literal: On dingmao of the fourth month he visited Longhu Gate, summoned chief ministers, academicians, senior generals of the Gold Crow, and great generals to attend a feast at Guanghua Monastery.

units.zh: 壬申，契丹遣使來貢。
units.en: On renshen Khitan envoys arrived with tribute.
units.literal: On renshen Khitan envoys came to offer tribute.

units.zh: 丁丑，幸宣威殿，宴文武官四品已上及軍使、蕃客。
units.en: On dingchou at Xuanwei Hall he feasted officials of fourth rank and above, army commissioners, and foreign guests.
units.literal: On dingchou he visited Xuanwei Hall and feasted civil and military officials of fourth rank and above, army commissioners, and foreign guests.

units.zh: 己卯，又幸左龍軍，宴群臣。
units.en: On jimao he again went to the Left Dragon Army and feasted the ministers.
units.literal: On jimao he again visited the Left Dragon Army and feasted the ministers.

units.zh: 詔曰：「邠、岐未滅，關、隴多虞，宜擇親賢，總茲戎任。
units.en: An edict read: "Bin and Qi are not yet subdued and the northwest is troubled—choose a close worthy to command the frontier.
units.literal: An edict stated: "Bin and Qi are not yet destroyed and Guan and Long are full of worry—it is fitting to choose a close worthy to take overall command of these military affairs.

units.zh: 應關西同、雍、華、鄜、延、夏等六道兵馬，並委冀王收掌指揮。
units.en: All forces of the six western circuits—Tong, Yong, Hua, Fu, Yan, and Xia—are placed under Prince of Ji to command.
units.literal: All troops of the six western circuits—Tong, Yong, Hua, Fu, Yan, and Xia—are entrusted to Prince of Ji to receive and direct.

units.zh: 凡有抽差，先申西面都招討使，仍別奏聞，庶合機權，以甯邊鄙。」
units.en: Any levy must be reported first to the western overall commander and then memorialized separately, so power fits need and the frontier is kept quiet."
units.literal: Whenever detachments are drawn, report first to the western overall commander and also memorialize separately, so that authority may suit circumstance and secure the border."

units.zh: 五月甲申朔，帝被冕旒禦朝元殿視朝，仗衛如式。
units.en: On jiashen, the first of the fifth month, the Emperor wore the crown at Chaoyuan Hall for audience, guards and escort as prescribed.
units.literal: On jiashen, first day of the fifth month, the Emperor wore the crown and presided at Chaoyuan Hall for court, guards and escort as prescribed.

units.zh: 制：改開平五年為乾化元年，大赦天下。
units.en: An edict changed Kaiping 5 to Ganhua 1 and proclaimed a great amnesty.
units.literal: An edict: Kaiping year 5 was changed to Ganhua 1 and there was a great amnesty for all under Heaven.

units.zh: 詔方伯州牧，近未加恩者，並遷爵秩。
units.en: Regional commissioners and prefects not yet rewarded were all raised in rank.
units.literal: An edict: regional commissioners and prefects recently not yet favored were all promoted in rank.

units.zh: 復大賚軍旅，普宴于宣威殿，賜帛各有差。
units.en: The armies were rewarded again; a general feast at Xuanwei Hall and graded gifts of silk.
units.literal: The armies were again richly rewarded; a general feast was held at Xuanwei Hall and silk granted in graded amounts.

units.zh: 制：封延州節度使高萬興為渤海郡王。
units.en: Yanzhou commissioner Gao Wanxing was enfeoffed Prince of Bohai.
units.literal: An edict: Yanzhou commissioner Gao Wanxing was enfeoffed as Prince of Bohai.

units.zh: 諸道節度使錢鏐、張宗奭、馬殷、王審知、劉隱各賜一子六品正員官，高季昌賜一子八品正員官，賀德倫賜一子九品正員官。
units.en: Commissioners Qian Liu, Zhang Zongshi, Ma Yin, Wang Shenzhi, and Liu Yin each received a regular sixth-rank post for a son; Gao Jichang an eighth-rank post; He Delun a ninth-rank post.
units.literal: Circuit commissioners Qian Liu, Zhang Zongshi, Ma Yin, Wang Shenzhi, and Liu Yin each had one son given a regular sixth-rank post; Gao Jichang one son eighth rank; He Delun one son ninth rank.

units.zh: 癸巳，觀稼于伊水，登建春門，幸會節坊張宗奭私第，臨亭皋視物色，賞賜甚厚。
units.en: On guisi he inspected crops on the Yi, climbed Jianchun Gate, visited Zhang Zongshi’s mansion in Huijie Ward, looked out from the pavilion over the landscape, and gave lavish rewards.
units.literal: On guisi he viewed the harvest on the Yi River, ascended Jianchun Gate, visited Zhang Zongshi’s private residence in Huijie Ward, overlooked the pavilion terrace to view the scenery, and rewards were very generous.

units.zh: 詔左銀台門，朝參諸司使庫使已下，不得帶從人入城，親王許一二人執條床手簡，餘悉止門外，闌入者抵律。
units.en: An edict on the Left Silver Terrace Gate: court officials from commissioners and storekeepers down might not bring attendants into the city. Princes might have one or two bearers with folding beds and tablets; all others halted outside. Intruders were punished by law.
units.literal: An edict on the Left Silver Terrace Gate: officials attending court from commissioners and storekeepers downward must not bring attendants into the city; princes may have one or two carrying folding beds and hand tablets—all others stop outside the gate; violators are punished by law.

units.zh: 閽守不禁，與所犯同。
units.en: Guards who failed to stop them shared the offense.
units.literal: Gate guards who do not stop them share the same offense.

units.zh: 先時，門通內無門籍，且多勳戚，車騎眾者，尤不敢呵察。
units.en: Before, the gate opened to the palace without registers, and many kinsmen of merit passed through; large retinues were rarely challenged.
units.literal: Earlier the gate communicated with the inner palace without gate registers, and there were many meritorious kin; those with large retinues of chariots and horses were especially not called to account.

units.zh: 至是有以客星淩犯上言者，遂令止隔。
units.en: When a memorial reported a guest star encroaching on the throne, he ordered the barrier enforced.
units.literal: Now because someone memorialized that a guest star was encroaching on the sovereign, he ordered the barrier enforced.

units.zh: 清海軍節度使、守侍中、兼中書令劉隱薨，輟朝三日，百僚詣閣門奉慰。
units.en: Liu Yin, Qinghai commissioner, acting palace attendant, and concurrent Secretariat director, died; court halted three days and officials offered condolences at the Gate Department.
units.literal: Qinghai military commissioner, acting palace attendant, and concurrent Secretariat director Liu Yin died; court was suspended three days and the hundred officials went to the Gate Department to offer condolences.

units.zh: 六月乙卯，命北面都招討使、鎮國軍節度使楊師厚出屯邢、洺。
units.en: On yimao in the sixth month he sent overall northern commander Yang Shihou, Zhenguo commissioner, to camp at Xing and Mo.
units.literal: On yimao of the sixth month he ordered overall northern commander and Zhenguo military commissioner Yang Shihou to encamp at Xing and Mo.

units.zh: 丁巳，鎮、定鈔我湯陰。
units.en: On dingsi the Zhen and Ding forces raided Tangyin.
units.literal: On dingsi Zhen and Ding raided our Tangyin.

units.zh: 詔曰：「常山背義，易水效尤，誘其蕃戎，動我邊鄙，南侵相、魏，東出邢、洺。
units.en: An edict read: "Changshan broke faith and Yishui copied it, rousing frontier tribes and stirring our borders, pushing south into Xiang and Wei and east toward Xing and Mo.
units.literal: An edict stated: "Changshan turned traitor and Yishui followed suit, enticing the frontier tribes and stirring our borderlands, invading south into Xiang and Wei and east out of Xing and Mo.

units.zh: 是用遣將徂征，為人除害，但初頒赦令，不欲食言，宥而伐之，諒非獲已。
units.en: I send generals to clear away harm—but we have just proclaimed an amnesty and I will not break my word; to pardon yet still strike is not what I desire.
units.literal: Therefore I send generals on campaign to remove harm for the people—but having just proclaimed an amnesty I do not wish to break my word; to spare yet still attack is surely not my wish.

units.zh: 況聞謀始，不自帥臣，致此厲階，並由奸佞。
units.en: I hear the plot did not start with the commanders; this disaster came from treacherous advisers.
units.literal: Moreover I hear the plot did not begin with the commanders themselves; this evil stage was all due to treacherous minions.

units.zh: 密通人使，潛結沙陀，既懼罪誅，乃生離叛。
units.en: They sent secret envoys and allied with the Shatuo; fearing punishment, they rebelled.
units.literal: They secretly sent envoys and quietly allied with the Shatuo; fearing punishment, they turned to rebellion.

units.zh: 今雖行討伐，已舉師徒，亦開詔諭之門，不阻歸降之路。
units.en: Though we march to punish them and armies are already raised, the door of edicts stays open and the road of surrender is not blocked.
units.literal: Though we now march to punish them and have already raised armies, we also open the gate of edicts and do not block the road of surrender.

units.zh: 矧又王熔、處直未曾削爵除名，若翻然改圖，不遠而復，必仍舊貫，當保前功。
units.en: Wang Rong and Chuzhi have not been stripped of rank; if they turn back soon, they keep their posts and their past merit.
units.literal: Moreover Wang Rong and Chuzhi have not yet been stripped of rank and name—if they turn back and return not far off, they shall keep their old posts and preserve their former merit.

units.zh: 如有率眾向明，拔州效順，亦行殊賞，冀徇來情，免令受弊於疲民，用示維新於汙俗。
units.en: Whoever leads men to submit, takes a prefecture, and proves loyal will receive special rewards, to spare the people and show renewal to a corrupted land.
units.literal: If any lead the masses toward the light, seize a prefecture and show loyalty, special rewards will also be granted, hoping to meet their intent, lest the weary people suffer harm and to show renewal to a tainted land.

units.zh: 宜令行營都招討使及陳暉軍前，准此敕文，散加招諭，將安眾懼，特舉明恩。
units.en: The campaign commander and Chen Hui at the front should circulate this edict, reassure the fearful, and proclaim mercy openly.
units.literal: The campaign overall commander and Chen Hui before the army should follow this edict, distribute persuasion widely, calm the people’s fear, and specially proclaim clear grace.

units.zh: 鎮州只罪李宏規一人，其餘一切不問。」
units.en: At Zhenzhou only Li Honggui is to be punished; all others go free."
units.literal: At Zhenzhou only Li Honggui is guilty; all others are not questioned."

units.zh: 詔修天宮佛寺。
units.en: An edict ordered the Heavenly Palace Buddhist monastery repaired.
units.literal: An edict ordered repair of the Heavenly Palace Buddhist monastery.

units.zh: 又，湖南奏：「潭州僧法思、桂州僧歸真並乞賜紫衣。」
units.en: Hunan also reported: "The monks Fasi of Tanzhou and Guizhen of Guizhou both request purple robes."
units.literal: Also, Hunan reported: "Tanzhou monk Fasi and Guizhou monk Guizhen both beg purple robes."

units.zh: 從之。
units.en: The request was granted.
units.literal: It was granted.

units.zh: 七月，帝不豫，稍厭秋暑。
units.en: In the seventh month the Emperor fell ill and grew weary of the autumn heat.
units.literal: In the seventh month the Emperor was unwell and somewhat weary of the autumn heat.

units.zh: 自辛丑幸會節坊張宗奭私第，宰臣視事於歸仁亭子，崇政使、內諸司及翰林院並止于河南令廨署，至甲辰，復歸大內。
units.en: From xinchou he stayed at Zhang Zongshi’s mansion in Huijie Ward; chief ministers worked from Guiren Pavilion; Chongzheng staff, inner offices, and the Hanlin lodged at the Henan prefect’s offices until jiachen, when he returned to the palace.
units.literal: From xinchou he visited Zhang Zongshi’s private residence in Huijie Ward; chief ministers conducted affairs at the Guiren Pavilion; Chongzheng commissioners, inner offices, and the Hanlin Academy all lodged at the Henan prefect’s yamen—until jiachen, when he returned to the inner palace.

units.zh: 八月庚申，幸保寧殿，閱天興控鶴兵事，軍使將校各有賜。
units.en: On gengshen in the eighth month he went to Baoning Hall, reviewed the Tianxing Crane-Control Army, and rewarded its commissioners and officers.
units.literal: On gengshen of the eighth month he visited Baoning Hall, reviewed Tianxing Crane-Control Army affairs, and army commissioners and officers each received gifts.

units.zh: 癸亥，老人星見。
units.en: On guihai the Old Man star appeared.
units.literal: On guihai the Old Man star appeared.

units.zh: 戊辰，幸故上陽宮，至於榆林觀稼。
units.en: On wuchen he went to the old Shangyang Palace and on to Yulin to inspect the crops.
units.literal: On wuchen he visited the former Shangyang Palace and went on to Yulin to view the harvest.

units.zh: 丙子，閱四蕃將軍、屯衛兵士于天津橋，南至龍門廣化寺。
units.en: On bingzi he reviewed Four Barbarian generals and garrison troops at Tianjin Bridge, south to Guanghua Monastery at Longmen.
units.literal: On bingzi he reviewed the Four Barbarian generals and garrison guards at Tianjin Bridge, south to Longmen’s Guanghua Monastery.

units.zh: 戊寅，幸興安鞠場大教閱，帝自指麾，無不踴抃，坐作進退，聲振宮掖。
units.en: On wuyin at Xing’an Ball Ground he held a grand review and directed in person; the men leapt and cheered; drill movements shook the palace quarter.
units.literal: On wuyin he visited Xing’an Ball Ground for a great review; the Emperor personally directed—none failed to leap and applaud; sitting, rising, advancing, and retreating shook the palace quarters.

units.zh: 右神武統軍丁審衢對禦，以紅帛囊劍擬乘輿物，帝曰：「宿將也。」
units.en: Ding Shenheng, Right Divine Martial commander, faced the throne with a sword wrapped in red silk as if toward the imperial carriage. The Emperor said: "A veteran."
units.literal: Right Divine Martial commander-in-chief Ding Shenheng faced the throne, using red silk to wrap a sword as if toward the imperial carriage; the Emperor said: "An old general."

units.zh: 恕之，以劉重霸代其任。
units.en: The Emperor pardoned him and put Liu Chongba in his place.
units.literal: The Emperor forgave him and replaced him with Liu Chongba.

units.zh: 九月辛巳朔，帝御文明殿，群臣入閣，刑法待制官各奏事。
units.en: On xinsi, the first of the ninth month, the Emperor held Wenhua Hall; ministers entered the side hall; penal-law awaiting-appointment officials each reported.
units.literal: On xinsi, first day of the ninth month, the Emperor presided at Wenhua Hall; the ministers entered the side hall; awaiting-appointment officials of penal law each reported on affairs.

units.zh: 己丑，宴群臣于興安殿。
units.en: On jichou he feasted the ministers at Xing’an Hall.
units.literal: On jichou he feasted the ministers at Xing’an Hall.

units.zh: 庚子，親禦六師，次於河陽。
units.en: On gengzi he personally led the Six Armies and stopped at Heyang.
units.literal: On gengzi he personally led the Six Armies and halted at Heyang.

units.zh: 甲辰，至於衛州。
units.en: On jiachen he reached Weizhou.
units.literal: On jiachen he reached Weizhou.

units.zh: 乙巳，至於宜溝，幸民劉達墅。
units.en: On yisi he reached Yigou and visited Liu Da’s farmhouse.
units.literal: On yisi he reached Yigou and visited the farmhouse of Liu Da.

units.zh: 丙午，至相州，賞左親騎指揮使張仙、右雲騎指揮使宋鐸，嘗身先陷陣，各賜帛。
units.en: On bingwu at Xiangzhou he rewarded Zhang Xian, Left Close Cavalry commander, and Song Duo, Right Cloud Cavalry commander, who had led charges in person, with silk each.
units.literal: On bingwu he reached Xiangzhou and rewarded Left Close Cavalry commander Zhang Xian and Right Cloud Cavalry commander Song Duo, who had led charges in person—each was granted silk.

units.zh: 十月辛亥朔，駐蹕於相州，宰臣洎文武從官並詣行宮起居。
units.en: On xinhai, the first of the tenth month, the court halted at Xiangzhou; chief ministers and the civil and military retinue attended at the traveling palace.
units.literal: On xinhai, first day of the tenth month, the imperial presence halted at Xiangzhou; chief ministers and civil and military followers all came to the traveling palace for audience.

units.zh: 戶部郎中孔昌序齎留都百官冬朔起居表至自西京，諸道節度使、刺史、諸籓府留後，各以冬朔起居表來上。
units.en: Kong Changxu of the Revenue Bureau brought the winter audience memorial from officials left in the capital, from the Western Capital; commissioners, prefects, and regents each sent winter audience memorials.
units.literal: Ministry of Revenue bureau director Kong Changxu brought the winter New Year audience memorial from the hundred officials left at the capital, arriving from the Western Capital; circuit commissioners, prefects, and frontier regents each sent winter New Year audience memorials.

units.zh: 制以郢王友圭充控鶴指揮使，諸軍都虞候閻寶為御營使。
units.en: Prince of Ying Yougui was made Crane-Control commander and Yan Bao, army chief of staff, imperial camp commissioner.
units.literal: An edict made Prince of Ying Yougui Crane-Control commander and army chief of staff Yan Bao imperial camp commissioner.

units.zh: 有司以立冬太廟薦享上言，詔丞相杜曉赴西都攝祭行事。
units.en: Offices reported on the Start-of-Winter ancestral rites; chief minister Du Xiao was sent to the Western Capital to officiate in proxy.
units.literal: The relevant office reported on the Start-of-Winter ancestral offering; an edict ordered chief minister Du Xiao to go to the Western Capital to perform the rites as proxy.

units.zh: 癸丑，閱武於州闉之南樓。
units.en: On guichou he reviewed troops on the south tower of the city gate.
units.literal: On guichou he reviewed troops on the south tower of the prefectural gate.

units.zh: 左龍驤都教練使鄧季筠、魏博馬軍都指揮使何令稠、右廂馬軍都指揮使陳令勳，以部下馬瘦，並腰斬於軍門。
units.en: Deng Jiyun, Left Dragon-Flying trainer, He Lingchou, Weibo horse commander, and Chen Lingxun, Right Wing horse commander, were beheaded at the army gate because their horses were emaciated.
units.literal: Left Dragon-Flying training commissioner Deng Jiyun, Weibo horse-army commander He Lingchou, and Right Wing horse-army commander Chen Lingxun—because their troops’ horses were thin—were all cut in two at the waist at the army gate.

units.zh: 甲寅，將以其夕幸魏縣，命閣門使李鬱報宰臣，兼敕內外。
units.en: On jiayin, planning to visit Weixian that evening, he had Gate Commissioner Li Yu notify the chief ministers and issued an edict within and without.
units.literal: On jiayin, intending that evening to visit Weixian, he ordered Gate Commissioner Li Yu to inform the chief ministers and also edict inside and outside.

units.zh: 是夜，車駕發軔於都署。
units.en: That night the imperial carriage departed the prefectural headquarters.
units.literal: That night the imperial carriage set out from the prefectural headquarters.

units.zh: 乙卯，次洹水。
units.en: On yimao he stopped at Huan River.
units.literal: On yimao he halted at Huan River.

units.zh: 丙辰，至魏縣。
units.en: On bingchen he reached Weixian.
units.literal: On bingchen he reached Weixian.

units.zh: 先鋒將黃文靖伏誅。
units.en: Vanguard Huang Wenjing was executed.
units.literal: Vanguard general Huang Wenjing was executed.

units.zh: 己未，帝御朝元門，以回鶻、吐蕃二大國首領入覲故也。
units.en: On jiwei he held Chaoyuan Gate because Uyghur and Tibetan chieftains had come to audience.
units.literal: On jiwei the Emperor presided at Chaoyuan Gate because chieftains of the two great states of the Uyghurs and Tibet had come to audience.

units.zh: 癸亥，令諸軍指揮使及四蕃將軍賜食于行宮之外廡。
units.en: On guihai he had army commanders and Four Barbarian generals fed in the outer corridors of the traveling palace.
units.literal: On guihai he ordered army commanders and Four Barbarian generals granted food in the outer corridors of the traveling palace.

units.zh: 戊辰，幸邑西之白龍潭以觀魚焉。
units.en: On wuchen he went to White Dragon Pool west of the county seat to watch the fish.
units.literal: On wuchen he visited White Dragon Pool west of the county seat to view the fish.

units.zh: 既而漁人獲巨魚以獻，帝命放之中流，從臣以帝有仁惻之心，皆相顧欣然。
units.en: Fishermen caught a great fish and presented it; the Emperor ordered it released midstream; his followers, seeing his compassion, exchanged pleased glances.
units.literal: Presently fishermen caught a huge fish and presented it; the Emperor ordered it released midstream; the followers, seeing the Emperor’s humane heart, looked at one another with pleasure.

units.zh: 是日，名其潭曰萬歲潭。
units.en: That day the pool was named Long-Life Pool.
units.literal: That day the pool was named Long-Life Pool.

units.zh: 丙子，帝御城東教場閱兵，諸軍都指揮、北面招討使、太尉楊師厚總領鐵馬步甲十萬，廣亙十數里陳焉。
units.en: On bingzi at the east-city drill ground the Emperor reviewed troops; Yang Shihou, army commander, northern commander, and grand marshal, led one hundred thousand horse and foot in a line more than ten li long.
units.literal: On bingzi the Emperor reviewed troops at the east-city drill ground; army commander and northern commander-in-chief and Grand Marshal Yang Shihou commanded one hundred thousand iron cavalry and infantry arrayed for more than ten li.

units.zh: 士卒之雄銳，部隊之嚴肅，旌旗之雜遝，戈甲之照耀，屹若山嶽，勢動天地，帝甚悅焉。
units.en: Troops were fierce, formations strict, banners dense, arms bright—like mountains, shaking heaven and earth. The Emperor was greatly pleased.
units.literal: The soldiers’ fierceness, the units’ discipline, the banners’ profusion, and the arms’ gleam stood like mountains; the momentum moved heaven and earth—the Emperor was greatly pleased.

units.zh: 即令丞相洎文武從臣列侍賜食，逮晚方歸。
units.en: He had chief ministers and the retinue stand in ranks to receive food and only returned at evening.
units.literal: He immediately ordered the chief minister and civil and military followers to stand in ranks and receive granted food; only at evening did they return.

units.zh: 十一月辛巳朔，上駐蹕魏縣，從官自丞相而下並詣行宮起居，留都文武百官及諸道節度使、防禦使、刺史、諸籓府留後，各奉表起居。
units.en: On xinsi, the first of the eleventh month, the court halted at Weixian; the retinue from the chief minister down attended; capital officials and commissioners, defense commissioners, prefects, and regents each sent audience memorials.
units.literal: On xinsi, first day of the eleventh month, the sovereign halted at Weixian; followers from the chief minister down all attended at the traveling palace; officials left in the capital and circuit commissioners, defense commissioners, prefects, and regents each sent audience memorials.

units.zh: 壬午，帝以邊事稍息，宣命還京師。
units.en: On renwu, with the frontier somewhat quieter, he ordered the return to the capital.
units.literal: On renwu the Emperor, because frontier affairs had eased somewhat, proclaimed orders to return to the capital.

units.zh: 《通鑒》：帝以夾寨、柏鄉屢失利，故力疾北巡，思一雪其恥，意鬱鬱，多躁忿，功臣宿將往往以小過被誅，眾心益懼。
units.en: 《Zizhi Tongjian》: After repeated defeats at Fortified Camp and Baixiang, he forced himself north though ill to redeem the shame; brooding and quick to rage, he often killed veteran generals for small faults, and fear spread.
units.literal: 《Zizhi Tongjian》: Because the Emperor had repeatedly lost at Fortified Camp and Baixiang, he forced himself north on tour though ill, thinking to wipe away the shame; his mood was depressed and he was often irritable and angry; meritorious old generals were often executed for small faults and hearts grew more fearful.

units.zh: 既而晉、趙兵不出。
units.en: The Jin and Zhao armies never appeared.
units.literal: Presently the Jin and Zhao armies did not come out.

units.zh: 十一月壬午，帝南還。
units.en: On renwu in the eleventh month the Emperor turned south.
units.literal: On renwu of the eleventh month the Emperor returned south.

units.zh: 車駕發自行闕，夕次洹水縣。
units.en: The court left the traveling palace and that evening stopped at Huan River county.
units.literal: The imperial carriage set out from the traveling palace and in the evening halted at Huan River county.

units.zh: 癸未，至內黃縣。
units.en: On guiwei he reached Neihuang county.
units.literal: On guiwei he reached Neihuang county.

units.zh: 甲申，至黎陽縣。
units.en: On jiashen he reached Liyang county.
units.literal: On jiashen he reached Liyang county.

units.zh: 乙酉，命從官丞相而下宴於行次。
units.en: On yiyou he feasted the retinue from the chief minister down at the halt.
units.literal: On yiyou he ordered followers from the chief minister down to feast at the halt.

units.zh: 丁亥，次衛州。
units.en: On dinghai he stopped at Weizhou.
units.literal: On dinghai he halted at Weizhou.

units.zh: 戊子晨，次新鄉，夕止獲嘉。
units.en: On wuzi at dawn he stopped at Xinxiang; by evening he was at Huojia.
units.literal: On wuzi at dawn he halted at Xinxiang; in the evening he stopped at Huojia.

units.zh: 己丑，次武陟。
units.en: On jichou he stopped at Wuzhi.
units.literal: On jichou he halted at Wuzhi.

units.zh: 庚寅，次溫縣。
units.en: On gengyin he stopped at Wen county.
units.literal: On gengyin he halted at Wen county.

units.zh: 延州節度使高萬興奏，當軍都指揮使高萬金統領兵士，今月五日收鹽州，偽刺史高行存泥首來降。
units.en: Gao Wanxing of Yanzhou reported that Gao Wanjin, army commander, took Salt Prefecture on the fifth of the month; the puppet prefect Gao Xingcun came in bonds to surrender.
units.literal: Yanzhou commissioner Gao Wanxing reported that army commander Gao Wanjin led troops and on the fifth of this month took Yanzhou; the false prefect Gao Xingcun came bound to surrender.

units.zh: 丞相及文武百官各上表稱賀。
units.en: Chief ministers and officials each submitted congratulations.
units.literal: The chief minister and civil and military officials each submitted congratulatory memorials.

units.zh: 辛卯，次孟州，命散騎常侍孫騭、右諫議大夫張衍、光祿卿李翼各齎香、祝版，告祭于孟津之望祠。
units.en: On xinmao at Mengzhou he sent Regular Attendant Sun Zhi, Right Reminder Zhang Yan, and Sacrifices Director Li Yi with incense and prayer boards to sacrifice at the Wang Shrine on the Meng Ford.
units.literal: On xinmao he halted at Mengzhou and ordered Regular Attendant Sun Zhi, Right Reminder Zhang Yan, and Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices Li Yi each to carry incense and prayer boards to offer sacrifice at the Wang Shrine on the Meng Ford.

units.zh: 留都文武官左僕射楊涉洎孟州守李周彝等皆匍匐東郊迎拜，其文武官並令先還。
units.en: Yang She, left vice director, Li Zhouyi, Mengzhou defender, and other capital officials prostrated themselves in the eastern suburbs to welcome him; civil and military officials were sent back first.
units.literal: Left Vice Director Yang She of the capital officials and Mengzhou defender Li Zhouyi and others all prostrated themselves in the eastern suburbs to welcome and bow; the civil and military officials were all ordered to return first.

units.zh: 壬辰，詰旦離孟州，晚至都。
units.en: On renchen he left Mengzhou at dawn and reached the capital by evening.
units.literal: On renchen at dawn he left Mengzhou and in the evening reached the capital.

units.zh: 宣宰臣各赴望祠禱雨。
units.en: Chief ministers were ordered each to the Wang Shrine to pray for rain.
units.literal: Chief ministers were announced to go each to the Wang Shrine to pray for rain.

units.zh: 故事，皆以兩省無功職事為之，帝憂民重農，尤以足食足兵為念，爰自御極，每愆阳积阴，多命丞相躬其事。
units.en: By precedent idle posts in the two departments handled it; the Emperor cared for the people and farming, mindful above all of full granaries and full ranks—since his accession, whenever drought or long gloom lingered, he often sent the chief minister in person.
units.literal: By precedent this was always done by idle posts in the two departments without merit; the Emperor cared for the people and valued farming, especially mindful of full bellies and full armies—since taking the throne, whenever drought or long yin accumulated, he often ordered the chief minister to perform it in person.

units.zh: 辛丑，大雨雪，宰臣及文武师长各奉表贺焉。
units.en: On xinchou came heavy rain and snow; chief ministers and military chiefs each sent congratulations.
units.literal: On xinchou there was heavy rain and snow; chief ministers and civil and military chiefs each submitted congratulatory memorials.

units.zh: 十二月，詔以時雪稍愆，命丞相及三省官各詣望祠祈禱。
units.en: In the twelfth month, with timely snow scarce, the chief minister and Three Departments officials were each sent to the Wang Shrine to pray.
units.literal: In the twelfth month an edict stated that timely snow was somewhat lacking and ordered the chief minister and Three Departments officials each to go to the Wang Shrine to pray.

units.zh: 癸酉，臘假，詔諸王與河南尹、左右金吾、六統軍等較獵于近苑。
units.en: On guiyou, La holiday, princes, the Henan prefect, the Gold Crow commanders, and the six army commanders were ordered to hunt together in the nearby park.
units.literal: On guiyou, on the La holiday, an edict ordered the princes with the Henan prefect, Left and Right Gold Crow, and the six army commanders-in-chief to compete in hunting in the nearby park.

units.zh: 命大理卿王鄯使于安南，左散騎常侍吳藹使於朗州，皆以旌節官誥錫之也。
units.en: Wang Shan, judicial review director, was sent to Annan and Wu Ai, left regular attendant, to Langzhou, each with banners of authority and commission patents.
units.literal: He appointed Court of Judicial Review director Wang Shan envoy to Annan and Left Regular Attendant Wu Ai envoy to Langzhou—both were granted banners of authority and commission patents.

units.zh: 又命將作少監薑宏道為朗州旌節官使副。
units.en: Jiang Hongdao, works vice-director, was made deputy banner envoy to Langzhou.
units.literal: He also appointed Directorate of Works vice-director Jiang Hongdao deputy banner envoy to Langzhou.

units.zh: 《五代會要》：舊制，巡撫、黜陟、冊命、吊贈、入蕃等使，選朝臣為之，其宣慰、加官、送旌節，即以中官為之，今以三品送旌節，新例也。
units.en: 《Five Dynasties Huiyao》: By old custom, inspection, promotion and demotion, investiture, condolence, and missions abroad went to court officials; consolation, promotion, and delivery of banners went to eunuchs—now third-rank officials carry banners, a new rule.
units.literal: 《Five Dynasties Huiyao》: By old rule, inspection, promotion and demotion, investiture, condolence, and entry to foreign lands envoys were chosen from court officials; consolation, promotion, and delivery of banners of authority were given to eunuchs—now third-rank officials deliver banners, a new precedent.

units.zh: 延州節度使高萬興奏，領軍於邠州界蒿子谷韋家寨，殺戮甯、慶兩州賊軍約二千餘人，並生擒都頭指揮使及奪馬器甲等事。
units.en: Gao Wanxing reported a raid at Weijia Stockade in Haozi Valley on the Bin border, killing some two thousand bandits of Ning and Qing and capturing commanders with horses, armor, and gear.
units.literal: Yanzhou commissioner Gao Wanxing reported leading troops at Weijia Stockade in Haozi Valley on the Binzhou border, killing about two thousand bandit troops of Ning and Qing prefectures, and capturing bandit commanders alive along with seized horses, armor, and gear.

units.zh: 其入奏軍將使宣召赴內殿賜對，以銀器彩物錫之，宰臣及文武官各奉表賀。
units.en: The reporting officer was summoned to the inner hall and given silver and silks; chief ministers and officials sent congratulations.
units.literal: The reporting army officer was announced and summoned to audience in the inner hall and granted silver vessels and colored goods; chief ministers and civil and military officials each submitted congratulatory memorials.

units.zh: 是月，魏博節度上言，於涇縣北戮殺鎮州王熔兵士七千餘人，奪馬二千餘匹，戈甲未知其數，並擒都將以下四十餘人。
units.en: That month Weibo reported slaughtering more than seven thousand of Wang Rong’s men north of Jing county, seizing two thousand horses, armor in unknown quantity, and forty-odd commanders.
units.literal: That month Weibo’s commissioner reported that north of Jing county he slaughtered more than seven thousand of Wang Rong’s Zhenzhou soldiers, seized more than two thousand horses, armor in unknown quantity, and captured more than forty commanders and below.

units.zh: 兩浙進大方茶二萬斤，琢畫宮衣五百副。
units.en: The two Zhes sent twenty thousand jin of brick tea and five hundred sets of carved palace robes.
units.literal: The two Zhes presented twenty thousand jin of large-block tea and five hundred sets of carved palace robes.

units.zh: 廣州貢犀象奇珍及金銀等，其估數千萬。
units.en: Guangzhou sent rhinoceros horn, ivory, rarities, and gold and silver estimated in the tens of millions.
units.literal: Guangzhou offered rhinoceros horn, elephant ivory, rare treasures, and gold and silver worth tens of millions by estimate.

units.zh: 安南兩使留後曲美，《通鑒》：十二月戊午，以靜海、曲美為節度使。
units.en: Annan’s envoys and regent Qu Mei—《Zizhi Tongjian》: On wuwu of the twelfth month Qu Mei of Jinghai was made military commissioner.
units.literal: Annan’s two envoys and regent Qu Mei—《Zizhi Tongjian》: On wuwu of the twelfth month Jinghai’s Qu Mei was made military commissioner.

units.zh: 進筒中蕉五百匹，龍腦、郁金各五瓶，他海貨等有差。
units.en: He presented five hundred bolts of tube-rolled plantain, five jars each of borneol and turmeric, and other overseas goods in graded amounts.
units.literal: He presented five hundred bolts of tube-rolled plantain, five jars each of borneol and turmeric, and other sea goods in graded amounts.

units.zh: 又進南蠻通好金器六物、銀器十二並乾陁綾花繓棖越啉毛等雜織奇巧者各三十件。
units.en: He also sent six gold and twelve silver friendship vessels from the south, and thirty each of ganduo brocade, huajiao, bing, yueling, and other exotic textiles.
units.literal: Also presented six gold vessels and twelve silver vessels for southern barbarian friendship, and thirty each of ganduo brocade, huajiao, bing, yueling, and other exotic woven goods.

units.zh: 福建進戶部所支榷課葛三萬五千匹。
units.en: Fujian presented thirty-five thousand bolts of Revenue Ministry monopoly ramie cloth.
units.literal: Fujian presented thirty-five thousand bolts of monopoly-tax ramie cloth paid by the Revenue Ministry.

units.zh: 梁太祖開平三年十一月，詔太常卿李燕、御史蕭頃、中書舍人張兗、戶部侍郎崔沂、大理卿王鄯、刑部郎中崔誥，共刪定律令格式。
units.en: In the eleventh month of the third year of Kaiping, Emperor Taizu of Liang ordered Grand Master of Splendid Happiness Li Yan, Censor Xiao Qing, Secretariat Drafter Zhang Chong, Vice Minister of Revenue Cui Yi, Minister of Justice Wang Shan, and Director of the Bureau of Punishments Cui Gao to revise the statutes, ordinances, formats, and regulations together.
units.literal: In the eleventh month of the third year of Kaiping of Emperor Taizu of Liang, an edict ordered Grand Master of Splendid Happiness Li Yan, Censor Xiao Qing, Secretariat Drafter Zhang Chong, Vice Minister of Revenue Cui Yi, Minister of Justice Wang Shan, and Director of the Bureau of Punishments Cui Gao jointly to revise the statutes, ordinances, formats, and regulations.

units.zh: 壬寅，開封府虞候李繼業齎襄州都指揮使程暉奏狀，以今月五日，殺戮逆黨千人，並生擒都指揮使傅霸以下節級共五百人，收復襄州人戶歸業事。
units.en: On renyin Li Jiye of Kaifeng Prefecture patrol delivered Cheng Hui’s report from Xiangzhou: on the fifth they had slain a thousand rebels, taken Fu Ba and some five hundred officers of command rank alive, and brought the people of Xiangzhou back to their fields.
units.literal: On renyin Kaifeng Prefecture patrol officer Li Jiye presented a memorial from Xiangzhou commander Cheng Hui stating that on the fifth of this month they killed a thousand rebels, captured over five hundred including military commissioner Fu Ba and those of command rank, and restored Xiangzhou households to their occupations.

units.zh: 《通鑒》：八月，陳暉軍至襄州，李洪逆戰，大敗，王求死。
units.en: 《Zizhi Tongjian》 records: In the eighth month Chen Hui reached Xiangzhou; Li Hong gave battle and was routed; Wang Qiu was killed.
units.literal: 《Zizhi Tongjian》: In the eighth month Chen Hui’s army reached Xiangzhou; Li Hong gave battle and was greatly defeated; Wang Qiu died.

units.zh: 開平三年九月癸巳朔，御崇勳殿，宴群臣文武百官。
units.en: On guisi, the first of the ninth month of Kaiping 3, the Emperor held court at Chongxun Hall and feasted chief ministers and the full civil and military establishment.
units.literal: On guisi, first day of the ninth month of Kaiping 3, the Emperor presided at Chongxun Hall and feasted the civil and military officials.

units.zh: 九月丁酉，拔其城，斬叛兵千人，執李洪、楊虔等送洛陽，斬之。
units.en: On dingyou in the ninth month the city fell; a thousand mutineers were beheaded and Li Hong, Yang Qian, and the rest were sent to Luoyang and executed.
units.literal: On the ninth month’s dingyou they took the city, beheaded a thousand mutinous troops, seized Li Hong, Yang Qian, and others and sent them to Luoyang for execution.

units.zh: 癸丑，以邠州節度使劉行琮卒廢朝，贈太傅。
units.en: On guichou Liu Xingcong of Bin died; court was suspended and he was posthumously grand tutor.
units.literal: On guichou Binzhou military commissioner Liu Xingcong died—court suspended; posthumously made Grand Tutor.

units.zh: 謙生隱，謙卒，隱代領其任。
units.en: Qian's son Yin succeeded him when Qian died and assumed his command.
units.literal: Qian begat Yin; when Qian died, Yin took over his post in his stead.

units.zh: 時唐室已季，彥若威令不振，事皆決於隱。
units.en: The Tang dynasty was already in decline, and Yanruo's authority no longer commanded obedience; Yin decided everything.
units.literal: The Tang house was already in its last days; Yanruo's prestige and orders did not carry weight, and all affairs were decided by Yin.

units.zh: 隱卒，弟陟襲位。
units.en: After Yin died, his younger brother Zhi took the throne.
units.literal: When Yin died, his younger brother Zhi succeeded to the position.

units.zh: 南漢劉鋹，其先蔡州上蔡人，高祖安仁，仕唐為潮州刺史，因家嶺表。
units.en: Liu Chang of Southern Han came from a line originally of Shangcai in Cai Prefecture. His great-grandfather Anren had served the Tang as prefect of Chaozhou and settled his family in Lingnan.
units.literal: Liu Chang of Southern Han — his ancestors were men of Shangcai in Cai Prefecture; his great-grandfather Anren served the Tang as prefect of Chaozhou and thereupon made his home in Lingnan.

units.zh: 梁開平初，兼靜海軍節度使，封南海王。
units.en: Early in the Liang Kaiping period he was also made military commissioner of the Jinghai army and created Prince of the Southern Sea.
units.literal: At the beginning of the Liang dynasty's Kaiping era he additionally held the commission of the Jinghai army and was enfeoffed as Prince of the Southern Sea.

units.zh: 唐昭宗以薛王知柔鎮南海，辟為行軍司馬，委以兵柄。
units.en: When Emperor Zhaozong posted the Prince of Xue, Zhi Rou, to the South Seas, Yin was made his chief of staff on campaign and given control of the army.
units.literal: Emperor Zhaozong of Tang sent the Prince of Xue, Zhi Rou, to govern the South Seas and appointed Yin chief of staff on campaign, entrusting him with military authority.

units.zh: 遠至江陵，遷延不進，乃以隱為留後，未幾，授以節旄。
units.en: Cui Yuan reached Jiangling but lingered without advancing, so Yin was made acting commissioner; shortly afterward he received the full commission.
units.literal: Yuan reached Jiangling but delayed and did not advance; Yin was then made acting commissioner, and before long he was granted the commissioner's insignia.

units.zh: 及宰相徐彥若代知柔，以為節度副使。
units.en: When Chief Minister Xu Yanruo succeeded Zhi Rou, Yin was appointed deputy military commissioner.
units.literal: When the chief minister Xu Yanruo replaced Zhi Rou, Yin was made deputy military commissioner.

units.zh: 彥若卒，遺表薦隱自代，昭宗不從，以崔遠代之。
units.en: On Yanruo's death he recommended Yin to succeed him in a final memorial, but Zhaozong refused and appointed Cui Yuan instead.
units.literal: When Yanruo died he left a memorial recommending Yin to succeed him; Zhaozong did not assent and sent Cui Yuan in his place.

units.zh: 《通鑒》：乙卯，博王友文來朝，請帝還東都。
units.en: 《Comprehensive Mirror》: On yimao the Prince of Bo, Youwen, attended court and urged the Emperor to return east.
units.literal: 《Comprehensive Mirror》: On yimao Prince of Bo Youwen came to court and asked the Emperor to return to the Eastern Capital.

units.zh: 己巳，至東都，博王友文以新創食殿上言，並進準備內宴錢三千貫、銀器一千五百兩。
units.en: On jisi he arrived at the Eastern Capital; Prince of Bo Youwen reported on the new Dining Hall and presented three thousand strings of cash and fifteen hundred taels of silver for an inner banquet.
units.literal: On jisi he reached the Eastern Capital; Prince of Bo Youwen memorialized on the newly built Dining Hall and also presented three thousand strings of cash and fifteen hundred taels of silverware prepared for an inner banquet.

units.zh: 制加建昌宮使、金紫光祿大夫、檢校司徒、開封尹、博王友文為特進、檢校太保，兼開封尹，依前建昌宮使，充東都留守。
units.en: By order Youwen, Prince of Bo, Jianchang palace commissioner, golden-seal grand master of splendid happiness, honorary grand mentor, and Kaifeng intendant, was raised to special court attendance and honorary grand guardian, kept Kaifeng intendant, and remained Jianchang commissioner and Eastern Capital custodian.
units.literal: An order advanced Jianchang Palace Commissioner, Grand Master of Splendid Happiness with Golden Seal and Purple Ribbon, Honorary Grand Mentor, Kaifeng Intendant, and Prince of Bo Youwen to Special Court Attendance and Honorary Grand Guardian, also Kaifeng Intendant, continuing as Jianchang Palace Commissioner and Eastern Capital Custodian.

units.zh: 次假子友文，帝特愛之，常留守東都，兼建昌宮使。
units.en: Next came the adopted son Youwen, the Emperor's favorite, who often stayed at the Eastern Capital as Jianchang palace commissioner.
units.literal: Next was the adopted son Youwen, whom the Emperor especially loved; he often remained at the Eastern Capital as Jianchang Palace Commissioner.

units.zh: 己卯，矯詔稱：「博王友文謀逆，遣兵突入殿中，賴郢王友珮忠孝，將兵誅之，保全朕躬。
units.en: On jimao a forged edict read: "Prince of Bo Youwen plotted revolt and burst into the hall with troops; Prince of Ying Yougui, loyal and filial, led forces to execute them and saved Us.
units.literal: On jimao a forged edict stated: "Prince of Bo Youwen plotted rebellion and sent troops bursting into the hall; thanks to Prince of Ying Yougui’s loyalty and filial piety, who led troops to execute them and preserved Our person.

units.zh: 遣供奉官丁昭溥馳詣東都，命均王友貞殺友文。
units.en: He sent palace attendant Ding Zhaopu in haste to the Eastern Capital to order Prince of Jun Youzhen to kill Youwen.
units.literal: He dispatched Palace Attendant Ding Zhaopu posthaste to the Eastern Capital ordering Prince of Jun Youzhen to kill Youwen.

units.zh: 辛巳，丁昭溥還，聞友文已死，乃發喪，宣遺制，友珪即皇帝位。
units.en: On xinsi Ding Zhaopu returned; learning Youwen was dead, they announced mourning, proclaimed the testament, and Yougui seized the throne.
units.literal: On xinsi Ding Zhaopu returned; hearing Youwen was already dead, they then announced the mourning, proclaimed the testamentary order, and Yougui at once took the throne.

units.zh: 帝雖未以友文為太子，意常屬之。
units.en: Youwen was not named crown prince, yet the Emperor's heart was often set on him.
units.literal: Although the Emperor had not made Youwen crown prince, his intent often rested on him.

units.zh: 光稠卒，全播立其子延昌而事之。
units.en: Guangchou died. Quanbo set up his son Yanchang and served him loyally.
units.literal: Guangchou died; Quanbo installed his son Yanchang and served him.

units.zh: 延昌好遊獵，其將黎求閉門拒延昌，延昌見殺。
units.en: Yanchang lived for the hunt. His general Li Qiu barred the gates against him and had him killed.
units.literal: Yanchang loved hunting and sport. His general Li Qiu shut the gates and barred Yanchang; Yanchang was killed.

units.zh: 荊南高季昌進瑞橘數十顆，質狀百味，倍勝常貢。
units.en: Gao Jichang of Jingnan sent dozens of auspicious oranges, finer in taste and look than ordinary tribute by far.
units.literal: Gao Jichang of Jingnan presented several tens of auspicious oranges, their quality and form a hundredfold better than ordinary tribute.

units.zh: 且橘當冬熟，今方仲夏，時人咸異其事，因稱為瑞。
units.en: Oranges ripen in winter, yet it was midsummer—men took it for a miracle and called them auspicious.
units.literal: Oranges should ripen in winter; now it was midsummer—people of the time all marveled at the matter and therefore called them auspicious.

units.zh: 五月，以唐朝宰臣張文蔚、楊涉並為門下侍郎、平章事；
units.en: In the fifth month former Tang chief ministers Zhang Wenwei and Yang She were both made Vice Directors of the Secretariat and Grand Councilors;
units.literal: In the fifth month, former Tang chief ministers Zhang Wenwei and Yang She were both made Vice Directors of the Secretariat and Grand Councilors;

units.zh: 盧光稠譚全播
units.en: Lu Guangchou and Tan Quanbo
units.literal: Lu Guangchou and Tan Quanbo

units.zh: 盧光稠、譚全播，皆南康人也。
units.en: Lu Guangchou and Tan Quanbo were both men of Nankang.
units.literal: Lu Guangchou and Tan Quanbo were both natives of Nankang.

units.zh: 光稠狀貌雄偉，無佗材能，而全播勇敢有識略，然全播常奇光稠為人。
units.en: Guangchou looked the part of a warlord but had little else to recommend him. Quanbo was brave and shrewd, yet he kept finding something remarkable in Guangchou’s character.
units.literal: Guangchou was imposing in bearing but had no other talent, while Quanbo was brave and possessed foresight—yet Quanbo often marveled at Guangchou as a man.

units.zh: 若欲成功，當得良帥，盧公堂堂，真君等主也。」
units.en: If you want to last, you need a real commander. Master Lu has the bearing of a lord—he is the man for you.”
units.literal: If you wish success, you must have a worthy commander. Master Lu is imposing—he is truly your proper lord.”

units.zh: 乃相與聚兵為盜。
units.en: They raised men and turned to the hills.
units.literal: They then together gathered troops and became bandits.

units.zh: 眾懼，乃立光稠為帥。
units.en: The men quailed, and Guangchou was made commander.
units.literal: The crowd was afraid, and thereupon installed Guangchou as commander.

units.zh: 太祖為置百勝軍，以光稠為防禦使、兼五嶺開通使，又建鎮南軍，以為留後。
units.en: Liang Taizu Zhu Wen raised the Hundred Victories Army, made Guangchou defense commissioner and commissioner to open the Five Ridges, then founded the Pacify-the-South Army and kept him as military governor.
units.literal: The Founder established the Hundred Victories Army, made Guangchou defense commissioner and concurrently commissioner for opening the Five Ridges, and also raised the Pacify-the-South Army and made him its military governor.

units.zh: 是時，王潮攻陷嶺南，全播攻潮，取其虔、韶二州，又遣光稠弟光睦攻潮州。
units.en: Wang Chao had seized Lingnan. Quanbo struck back, took Qian and Shao from him, and sent Guangchou’s brother Guangmu against Chaozhou.
units.literal: At that time Wang Chao had overrun Lingnan. Quanbo attacked Chao and took his Qian and Shao prefectures, and also sent Guangchou’s younger brother Guangmu to attack Chaozhou.

units.zh: 開平五年，光稠病，以符印屬全播，全播不受。
units.en: In Kaiping 5 (911) Guangchou fell ill and pressed his seals on Quanbo. Quanbo refused.
units.literal: In the fifth year of Kaiping, Guangchou fell ill and entrusted his seals to Quanbo; Quanbo would not accept them.

units.zh: 唐末，群盜起南方，全播謂光稠曰：「天下洶洶，此真吾等之時，無徒守此貧賤為也！」
units.en: As Tang collapsed, rebels swarmed the south. Quanbo told Guangchou: “The empire is boiling over. This is our moment—don’t waste it clinging to poverty and obscurity!”
units.literal: At the end of Tang, bandits rose throughout the south. Quanbo said to Guangchou: “The realm is in uproar—this is truly our hour; do not merely sit guarding this poverty and low station!”

units.zh: 梁初，江南、嶺表悉為吳與南漢分據，而光稠獨以虔、韶二州請命於京師，願通道路，輸貢賦。
units.en: Early in Liang, Jiangnan and Lingnan were carved up between Wu and Southern Han. Guangchou alone held Qian and Shao, bowed to the court, and asked for roads and tribute.
units.literal: At the beginning of Liang, Jiangnan and Lingnan were all divided between Wu and Southern Han, while Guangchou alone with Qian and Shao two prefectures submitted to the capital, wishing to open roads and deliver tribute.

units.zh: 光稠大懼，謂全播曰：「虔、潮皆公取之，今日非公不能守也。」
units.en: Guangchou was terrified. He told Quanbo: “You won Qian and Chao for us. Only you can hold them now.”
units.literal: Guangchou was greatly afraid and said to Quanbo: “Qian and Chao were both taken by you; today if not for you they cannot be defended.”

units.zh: 光稠第戰功，全播悉推諸將，光稠心益賢之。
units.en: When honors were handed out, Quanbo gave every laurel to his generals. Guangchou admired him all the more for it.
units.literal: When Guangchou ranked battle merit, Quanbo pushed all credit to the generals, and Guangchou’s heart esteemed him all the more.

units.zh: 留都文武禮部尚書孔續而下道左迎拜。
units.en: Civil and military officials left in the capital, from Minister of Rites Kong Xu down, lined the road to welcome him.
units.literal: Capital custodian civil and military officials from Minister of Rites Kong Xu down met and bowed on the left of the road.

units.zh: 以丁審衢為陳州，而審衢厚以鞍馬、金帛為謝恩之獻，帝慮其漁民，復其獻而停之。
units.en: Ding Shenqu was appointed prefect of Chenzhou; he sent lavish gifts of saddles, horses, and silks in thanks for the appointment. Fearing he would fleece the people, the Emperor returned the gifts and refused them.
units.literal: Ding Shenqu was appointed to Chenzhou, but Shenqu lavishly offered saddles, horses, and silks as thanks for grace; the Emperor, fearing he preyed on the people, returned the gifts and stopped him.
